info.title: Porta Delivery API | بورتا للتوصيل
info.description:
API-first intercity delivery backend. Money is integer LYD millimes (scale 3). All dates use ISO 8601; business-day filters use Africa/Tripoli. All JSON requests must be objects (maximum 65,536 bytes); duplicate query/JSON keys are rejected. Write parameters belong only in the JSON body. Administrative operations require permission checks and branch/driver ownership where applicable.

Browser authentication: (1) send GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie with credentials and an allowed Origin or Referer; (2) read and URL-decode the XSRF-TOKEN cookie; (3) POST /api/v1/auth/login with credentials and X-XSRF-TOKEN; (4) retain the secure HttpOnly session cookie and include the CSRF header on unsafe requests. The example cookie name is the default from APP_NAME=Porta Delivery; SESSION_COOKIE can override it. Login regenerates the session; logout invalidates it. Bearer authentication is deliberately rejected by this release. Browser frontend origins must be configured in SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS/CORS. Use HTTPS in production.

Critical writes require a random Idempotency-Key of 32–128 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Reuse it for the same method/path/body only; mismatched reuse returns 409. Successful replays preserve the result and use a new request_id. Errors never include stack traces or SQL.

post.description: Requires a SCHEDULED or LOADING trip and 1–200 distinct existing shipment IDs. Every shipment must be RECEIVED or PREPARING, have no trip membership (including this trip), and match the trip's origin_city_id, destination_city_id and branch_id exactly. Both branch IDs may be null; null does not match an assigned branch. PREPARING is required for departure, not attachment. The trip driver is optional; if assigned, the driver must be active. Attachment atomically sets each shipment's assigned_driver_id to the trip's driver_id, including null, without changing shipment status; prior driver equality is not required. Domain conflicts return 409 with a safe reason message and no partial membership changes. A successful same-key, same-body retry replays the result; a fresh-key attempt to attach an existing member conflicts.

delete.description: Requires a SCHEDULED or LOADING trip and a shipment currently belonging to that trip, with the existing trip access and assignment permission. Detachment atomically clears the shipment's trip_id and assigned_driver_id, preserving shipment status. Wrong membership returns 404; a trip outside the loadable states returns 409.
